- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for consecutive positive sentiment.
- Underestimate prices after strong downward spikes (sentiment < 0.0) — add 3–8% buffer to forecast if sentiment turns positive within 3 days.
- Overshoot after recent price peaks — cap forecast at 10–15% below prior peak if sentiment is neutral or negative.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 14-day moving average, reduce by 1–3% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment was high 3–5 days prior, forecast should be 1–3% lower than model output to account for delayed market reaction.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate in early 2024 (post-2024-08-26) — apply 5–10% downward adjustment if sentiment is weak or mixed.
